svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Web application on Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud
svg.desc: Web application on Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud. 20 components in 9 groups. Connections: Web browser to Cloud Internet Services (HTTPS 443); Mobile app to Cloud Internet Services (HTTPS 443); Mobile app to App ID (sign in); Cloud Internet Services to Cloud Object Storage (static content); Cloud Internet Services to VPC Load Balancer (API calls); VPC Load Balancer to Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud (across 3 zones); Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud to Virtual Private Endpoints; Virtual Private Endpoints to Container Registry (pull images); Virtual Private Endpoints to Databases for PostgreSQL (SQL); Virtual Private Endpoints to Cloud Object Storage (backups); Virtual Private Endpoints to Secrets Manager (certificates); Virtual Private Endpoints to Key Protect (keys); Virtual Private Endpoints to IBM Cloud Logs (logging agent); Virtual Private Endpoints to IBM Cloud Monitoring (monitoring agent); Operations team to Client VPN for VPC (OpenVPN); Client VPN for VPC to Bastion hosts (3) (SSH 22).

text.tspan: Web application on Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud
Cloud Internet Services serves the static site from Object Storage and sends API calls to a three-zone OpenShift cluster in a VPC
Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud
